products.title: Lumo M1 Putter
products.body_html:
Nordic design meets modern performance. LUMO M1 is a low-torque mallet putter that offers stability for more forgiveness, a solid feel and elite playability.

LUMO M1 balances control with confidence at address. Low-torque putting has never made more sense.

Comes assembled with a SuperStroke grip and includes a headcover made from 100% recycled fabric.

products.title: Lumo B1 Putter
products.body_html:
Redefining the modern blade. LUMO B1 is a low-torque blade putter that offers stability, timeless design and a crisp, responsive feel.

LUMO B1 balances forgiveness and distance control with premium construction—but without the premium price tag.

Comes assembled with a SuperStroke grip and includes a headcover made from 100% recycled fabric.

products.title: Ignis D2 Driver
products.body_html:
Fear no drive. The IGNIS D2 Driver is built for players who value consistency, even on off-center strikes. Featuring a titanium body beneath a carbon crown, Takomo’s redesigned flagship driver delivers easier launch and more forgiveness than ever.

Premium reliability. No sticker shock. Bag appeal like no other.

Comes in with a headcover, adjustment wrench, and an additional 8g weight. 3g weight pre-installed.

products.title: Takomo Gift Card
products.body_html:
You need something easy and fast… like a gift card!

Give your beloved golf fanatic a Takomo Golf gift card. Delivered via email immediately. Redeemable on takomogolf.com for 5 years.

products.title: Classic Polo
products.body_html:
The Takomo Classic Polo is crafted from a thin, highly elastic material that moves easily with you through every swing. Lightweight and flexible, it reflects the Nordic approach to design: simple, functional, and made to be worn often.

Limited edition. Once it’s gone, it’s gone. US only.

products.title: Ignis D2 Fairway Wood
products.body_html:
Easy launch, forgiveness, and a higher-spinning flight built for accuracy and consistency. The IGNIS D2 Fairway Wood is designed to help you keep long shots under control and make confident swings when precision matters.

A clean, confident shape completes a fairway wood that looks as reliable as it plays.

Available in 3, 5, and 7 wood. Wrench and headcover included.

products.title: Stand Bag 02
products.body_html:
Our bag game is back with the premium Stand Bag 02, blending distinct Takomo elegance and tour-proven functionality in two gorgeous colors. Pick your favorite, put stuff in it, and hit the golf course. That's all there's to it, really.

US & EU only!
